name: gedit
description: A general-purpose text editor for GNOME.
summary: Contributions generated by LLM tools and chatbots are not allowed anywhere in the project. The only exception is translating issue and comment text into English.

evidence.quote: This project does not allow contributions generated by large languages models (LLMs) tools and chatbots. This ban applies to all parts of the project.
An exception applies for purely translating texts for issues and comments to English.

sources.title: Gedit Development Guidelines: No Large Language Models AI tools
